findings.finding: The capability-status resolver accepts a generic self-asserted artifact receipt and copies its status without validating the mode-specific required evidence or exact artifact references.
The aggregate canonical suite blocks: 14 preacceptance closure tests error during fixture setup because joined_driver_digest is required but omitted; only six teardown tests pass.

Plan source v1 and its compiler emit only WPRA config, a generated human Work Pack, two WPRA runs, and a source-validation receipt; they cannot emit the complete high-complexity execution-candidate family promised by the Plan contract.

Define and Design have real bounded validators but no atomic final-bundle producers; Handoff has no mode producer or validator; Refresh validates material/handoff evidence but does not produce or atomically apply its promised report and patch family.

Preacceptance names actual consumer boundaries but uses development adapters for several stages, while Invoke closeout and Task Session terminal are schema consumers rather than production transformations.
Preacceptance produces request v2 and validates response v1, while the accepted-stream bridge consumes response v2 and request v3 has no selected canonical producer route.
The mode capability table omits mandatory evidence newly required by Define, Design, Plan and Refresh contracts, so capability resolution cannot enforce the published contracts.
Accepted-stream schemas/runtime are increasingly frontier-generic, but self-check CLIs require historical SWU-MVLR sentinel IDs and the producer-closure matrix proves only one 14-unit fixture.
Root documentation labels five modes active or implemented although none currently has proven complete end-to-end production and consumer closure.

Full is unsupported and has no implementation. It can be removed, but removal must update the root router, mode table, capability schemas/fixtures, Handoff route choices, templates, generated mirrors, and compatibility expectations as one bounded change.

Public Invoke documentation and templates contain a named private product-family coupling; publication policy should replace it with a generic profile or explicitly document an approved public boundary.

passing_evidence.capability_status_tests: 13/13 tests pass but prove the weak current contract

recommended_repair_order: Harden capability-status evidence admission and correct mode status claims.
Restore the red preacceptance regression and require the complete suite green.
Replace schema/development consumer substitutions and select one request-response family.
Complete or downgrade Define, Design, Handoff and Refresh mode claims.
Remove deferred Full as a separate compatibility-closed slice.
Run one new generic end-to-end laboratory workflow through Refine, Invoke and downstream consumers.
